limits: No hosted authenticated staff-page or provider-write acceptance; current login wall remains.
Browser uses actual pages/client consumers/Workspace/CSS with explicit local Shell/navigation/error-boundary/action transport adapters; full Next RSC/proxy/streaming semantics remain separate.

PostgREST transport fixture and JavaScript literal matching do not establish deployed SQL plans, collation, indexes or latency. Exact counts/search run server-side; no unbounded all-record payload fetch.
Separate HEAD and page reads are not a single transactional snapshot; concurrent data changes can require refresh.
Offset paging has stable tie ordering but does not freeze a mutable dataset across requests.
More than1,000 referrals for one25-application page fails with unavailable evidence instead of rendering incomplete vouch data; no new aggregate backend contract is activated.
A positive controlled triage RPC receipt verifies submitted form/actor payload, not a hosted assignment mutation.
The first-pass283-binding coverage denominator is unchanged. These regressions do not convert all actions/routes/bindings to accepted.
Backendstage4 unresolved original requests and other parent-owned platform findings remain outside this repair.
